checks.title: Ensure Telnet is disabled on VTY lines
checks.rationale: Telnet transmits authentication credentials and configuration in cleartext across the network. Enforcing SSHv2 protects administrative sessions.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
line vty 0 15
transport input ssh
end

checks.title: Ensure HTTP server is disabled
checks.rationale: Cleartext HTTP server daemon presents an unencrypted management vector susceptible to credential interception.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
no ip http server
end

checks.title: Ensure SSH version 2 is enforced
checks.rationale: SSH version 1 contains fundamental cryptographic flaws. Enforce SSHv2 for all remote administration.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
ip ssh version 2
end

checks.title: Ensure VTY exec-timeout is configured between 1 and 15 minutes
checks.rationale: Unattended administrative sessions must terminate automatically after a short period of inactivity to prevent physical/remote session hijacking.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
line vty 0 15
exec-timeout 10 0
end

checks.title: Ensure Enable Secret uses secure hashing algorithm (Type 8 or Type 9)
checks.rationale: Legacy enable secret Type 5 hashes (MD5) can be reversed via rainbow tables. Type 8 (PBKDF2) or Type 9 (scrypt) must be enforced.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
enable algorithm-type scrypt secret <password>
end

checks.title: Ensure default VLAN 1 is not used for trunk native traffic
checks.rationale: Using VLAN 1 as the native trunk VLAN exposes the switch to double-tagging and 802.1Q VLAN hopping attacks. Assign a dedicated, unused non-default VLAN ID.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
interface <trunk-interface>
switchport trunk native vlan 999
end

checks.title: Ensure Port Security is enabled on access switchports
checks.rationale: Port Security enforces MAC address limits on edge access ports, preventing CAM table overflow (MAC flooding) attacks.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
interface <interface>
switchport mode access
switchport port-security
switchport port-security maximum 2
switchport port-security violation restrict
end

checks.title: Ensure DHCP Snooping is globally enabled
checks.command: show ip dhcp snooping | include DHCP snooping is
checks.rationale: DHCP Snooping drops unauthorized DHCP server offers on untrusted access ports, preventing rogue DHCP man-in-the-middle attacks.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
ip dhcp snooping
ip dhcp snooping vlan 1-4094
end

checks.title: Ensure Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI) is enabled
checks.command: show ip arp inspection vlan | include Vlan
checks.rationale: Dynamic ARP Inspection uses the DHCP snooping database to validate ARP responses, preventing ARP cache poisoning.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
ip arp inspection vlan <vlan-id>
end

checks.title: Ensure Spanning Tree BPDU Guard is enabled globally on access ports
checks.command: show running-config | include spanning-tree portfast bpduguard
checks.rationale: BPDU Guard protects STP topology stability by disabling any edge port that unexpectedly receives Spanning Tree BPDUs.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default
end

checks.title: Ensure unused switchports are administratively disabled
checks.rationale: Unused physical switchports must be administratively shut down and assigned to an isolated unrouted parking VLAN to block unauthorized rogue physical connections.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
interface range <unused-interfaces>
shutdown
switchport access vlan 999
end

checks.title: Ensure VTY lines enforce management access-class ACL
checks.rationale: Source-IP filtering via access-class restricts VTY management sessions to authorized administration workstations and jumpboxes only.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
ip access-list standard MGMT-HOSTS
permit 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255
line vty 0 15
access-class MGMT-HOSTS in
end

checks.title: Detect overly permissive ACL rules (permit ip any any)
checks.command: show ip access-lists | include permit ip any any
checks.rationale: Overly broad permit ip any any rules nullify network access control and allow unrestricted lateral movement.
checks.remediation: Remove blanket any-any statements and replace with specific IP source, destination, and port restrictions.

checks.title: Ensure remote Syslog server is configured
checks.rationale: Local buffer logs are easily cleared upon power-cycle or evasion. System security logs must be shipped to a centralized SIEM.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
logging host <syslog-server-ip>
logging trap informational
end

checks.title: Ensure NTP time synchronization is configured
checks.rationale: Accurate system time is essential for forensic log timestamp correlation across disparate network elements.

checks.title: Ensure default SNMP community strings (public/private) are removed
checks.rationale: Default community strings public and private allow unauthorized attackers to query or modify device configuration over SNMP.
checks.remediation:
configure terminal
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
end
